searchText: Um, sorry, where? I don't see it in the ethmagicians thread, and I don't see a PR for 7870 on github ethereum/EIPs. What am I not looking at that I should be? 😅 Where are we proposing EIPS PFIs? I'd like to propose these two (one has no changes) https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/10218 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/10220 https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4522 To propose an EIP, you can open a PR to the Glamsterdam Meta EIP and add it to the list 🙂 https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7773#proposed-for-inclusion i commented on here: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/hardware-and-bandwidth-recommendations-for-full-nodes-and-validators/22675/11?u=rolfyone maybe not the best place? Ah. I did see that comment - I was hoping there’d be one that actually had the requirements for a supernode <:harold:1019414542075297892> I know it’s “more bandwidth”, but not how much. And I don’t know what the impact on CPU and memory is, if any To be honest that's why i posted it, i dont know what they'll be but im sure they're going to be unique...
